title_en: You (O Ali) Are My Successor After Me - Part 30
description_en: المرجعية والخلافة بعد الرسول(ص) 6 / ذي الحجة /1432
summary: In this lecture, His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari discusses the prophetic tradition regarding Ali ibn Abi Talib being his successor.
